'''Watcher''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was responsible for the raising and lowering of the stone portcullis that protected [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]]. The Watcher kept note of temperature changes, wind and dust patterns and when they observed a [[heat storm]], ordered the portcullis to be closed to protect the city.
